changes.title: Japanese Gun Cooldown Aim Mechanic Timer

current.changeLog: Changed to a res_mods folder mod.

Added gun caliber, ammunition capacity, and penetration at 500 meters to the vehicle statistics. Improved Firepower ordering and shell-selection presentation. Added Shell Calibration support to Armor Inspector. Added a vanilla-style attacker shell-mode switch for vehicles such as the Pz.Kpfw. Neu. Added native-style Tier XI upgrades to the Loadout Sandbox. Selecting an advanced Tier XI upgrade now automatically activates its prerequisites; selecting the final upgrade activates the complete tree. Tier XI upgrade trees now scale to fit without scrolling. Restored native field-modification level and upgrade icons. Made sandbox selections respond immediately while statistics recalculate in the background. Significantly improved Loadout Sandbox scrolling speed. Improved compatibility with World of Tanks 2.4.
